justification: `src/main/java/org/jsoup/helper/package-info.java` describes this as the package supporting core jsoup code, and the package contains 16 production source files totaling 3,590 LOC (`HttpConnection.java` 1,423 LOC; `W3CDom.java` 462; `DataUtil.java` 414; `HttpClientExecutor.java` 187; others 28-240 LOC). The classes span many unrelated responsibilities in one package: HTTP transport/execution (`HttpConnection`, `RequestExecutor`, `RequestDispatch`, `UrlConnectionExecutor`, `HttpClientExecutor`), authentication (`AuthenticationHandler`, `RequestAuthenticator`, `RequestAuthHandler`), cookies (`CookieUtil`), URL normalization (`UrlBuilder`), data loading (`DataUtil`), DOM conversion (`W3CDom`), regex abstraction (`Regex`, `Re2jRegex`), and validation (`Validate`, `ValidationException`).
